exercises.prompt: This isn't any scarier than the Germans.
exercises.why: The comparative degree of Russian adjectives is formed by adding "-ее" (sometimes shortened to "-ей") to the stem of the adjective: новый — новее; красивый — красивее. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 80, 82.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
